The smell is okay, but not as nice as some other foods. This is meant to be a food with nutrients, but honestly, I would only use this for a treat a few times a week- and just about 7 or 8 pieces per cat.

IS THE BAG RESEALABLE?
You can reseal the bag.

HOW WOULD THIS FIT INTO A CAT WHO GETS HOMEMADE FOOD?
I would not feed this to male cats as the dry nature can make them more prone to crystals in the urine. However, in tiny amounts as a treat only, it will work well with home made food.

DO THE CATS LIKE IT?
Both of our cats are used to home made food (we always add proper amounts of nutrients including taurine) so they don't tend to like a lot of processed foods for long periods of time. This time, however, I found that as a treat a few times a week, both cats love these.

THE BOTTOM LINE
As a food, I do not recommend this- it is WAY too expensive. As a treat to have on hand and give occasionally in smal amounts, yes. Our cats do like it.

FIVE STARS when used as a treat. As a regular food, it is just too expensive.

title: My three cats won't use this litter; I also do not like that I cannot sift through the crystals with my largest scoop
text:
I've been using Fresh Step clumping litter for over 20 years and have tried other litters during that time. There is no litter that comes close to the quality of Fresh Step, not even Tidy Cat, Cat's Pride, or Arm & Hammer. Nevertheless, I wanted to give this brand a try.

Over the past week I have tried to get my three cats to use this and they will not even venture into the litter pan. I then combined some of this litter with their Fresh Step scoopable and they begrudgingly used the box as long as this litter was no more than one scoopful. Nevertheless, even if they used this, I would give it one star.

NEGATIVES

- The litter has such large rock-salt-looking crystals that it will not sift through my widest spaced scoop. (See picture of my scoop and also a picture of the litter just pleasantly sitting in my scoop.) The instructions say to fully empty the box every two weeks or when the litter becomes saturated. However, in my house the litter would not last more than two days because so much of it will be removed when scooping the waste.

- Although it says 99% dust free, I am not so sure. A cloud of dust went into my face as I was pouring this in the pan.

POSITIVE

- The side handle on the package makes the litter easy to pour and grab

OTHER CLAIMS
- The bag says this litter traps and eliminates urine and feces odors. I cannot attest to this because my cats will not use it.

- Also, the large crystals are supposed to reduce tracking. This may be true but once again, unless my cats use this litter, I cannot tell. They did not track any of the crystals when I combined it with my Fresh Step but that is not a definitive test.

In summary, my cats give this one star because they will not use it and I give it one star because it cannot be sifted while scooping as the crystals are too large.

title: Dogs loved this so much a dog fight broke out but, in my opinion, this is not so healthy
text:
My friend runs a dog foster home and I tried it on three of the dogs. We put this on top of their food and they ate it ravishingly. One problem we had is that one dog did not want to eat his regular food once he finished this. That dog started fighting with the other dog in an effort to steal the morsels that were left over in his dish. She quickly had to break up a dog fight.

DETAILS:

- This is designed to enhance and add variety to a dog's meals by adding this on top of their regular food.

- It's listed as 100% complete and balanced.

- Although it's manufactured in USA, the box does not say where the ingredients are sourced from.

- The box says it's made with real beef, yet beef is the 10th ingredient.

- There are 9 pouches of "moist" morsels. Each pouch is probably 4 ounces each since there are 36 ounces in the box.

- The pouches are clear plastic with no quantity or writing on the package.

The verdict, the dogs loved it to the exclusion of their own food. I can see using this to encourage a dog to eat a special diet food (even though they should not have any other food) or to encourage a sick or finicky eater. From this perspective, I think it's worth it's weight in gold. Other than this, I consider this an expensive (at the current price of $13.59 for 9 pouches), sort of unhealthy, food additive with ingredients that starts with meat-by-products, soy flour, soy grits, and high fructose corn syrup, etc. in that order.

The dogs give this five stars but I give it two stars for nutrition; hence the 3-star rating.

I've attached three images. One shows the plastic pouch, the other the ingredients list and guaranteed analysis, and the third a picture of the amount to be fed by dog weight.

title: I Was Pulling My Hair Out When This Arrived In The Mail..
text:
I have two cats with more drama than any of my kids has EVER had. One of them is on an intermittent Ghandi style protest fast, and the other one used to eat anything, until learning bad habits from her idol- our grumpy male cat who does not want her around. I was pulling my hair out the other day with no one eating any food repeatedly (including their favorites) when this arrived in the delivery. LEt's see what happened.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
You get two of each type of food. There are blends of chicken and seafood or just plain chicken with egg or chicken itself. The packs are foil packs. They are enough for one meal of the day assuming you are feeding two meals a day.

MOUSSE
This is a mousse style- that means it is less chunks and more creamy, although some flavors have chunks in them.

HOW DID OUR CATS LIKE THIS?
I took one of these packets and split it between the two cats mixing it with the rejected food. Miraculously they both ate! I have used it many times in the last few days to get them to eat the food they are rejecting all of a sudden. It has been a hit when NOTHING was getting our older male cat to eat.

PROBLEMS?
The one thing that is difficult about these is getting the food out. There is a lot left in the packets, but I just fill it with water, fold the top down and shake well. Then I pour this over the food as gravy.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a great variety of food that was a shock to me when our cats ate it, this is great to have around the house. At least with the variety pack, you can find out what your cat or cats like and buy that in the future.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This stuff has been a godsend in a very difficult week when I was not in the mood to struggle with cat drama. I am not fond of the packets being hard to get all of the food out of, but the fact that they are eating it is thrilling on its own.

text:
My dogs go through lots of treats. They are part of their daily diet but one issue I have is that most treats do not last very long. I like having treats that can keep my dog buy for more than a few seconds and one that does exactly that is Best Bully Sticks.

Shaped like a cylinder, these dog treats are comprised of a hard, outer shell with a tasty filling. The outside isn’t rawhide, which is good because I don’t trust rawhide for my dogs and rarely give it to them. Dogs will chew and try to get at the filling, which is where the tasty treat lies. Once they are finished, if the outer shell is still in good shape, you can refill it and give it to your dog again, for another round of fun.

The hard outer coating of this treat is good for your dog’s teeth and best of all, the treats are long lasting. Dogs can chew and chew, and the outer shell can handle it. I like giving my dogs a treat like this when I want them to remain occupied for a long time. It does the trick, and they love the tasty filling inside.

title: fresh peppermint aroma, labs are chill, 25 per 25 oz bag (1oz per chew)
text:
We love Zesty Paws items. With 4 cats and 2 labs, it is a brand we have purchased many times for an assortment of supplements. When the Calming Dental Sticks came up as an option to try, I was intrigued by them. My two labs don't have a direct need for a calming supplement, but the dental aspect of it was of interest to me. Upon opening the bag I could detect the peppermint oil. The sticks have a fresh peppermint aroma. I wasn't sure if my picky (yes, picky) labs would like these or not, but my girl took to her stick right away, and after some inspection my boy also ate his. I am not sure if they were ready for a nap, but both just seemed kinda extra chill. My labs are pretty laid back, but I think if these are adding to their calm state, then I may make a point to utilize them prior to scenarios that may be a little too exciting or stress inducing. Namely, I am thinking vet visits, novel environments, and working on transitioning my young boy from crate to house (he is only in crate when no one is at home, and at max 4 hours, maybe 1-2 x a week). His big sister has run of the house and we'd like for him to be able to enjoy the same privilege. Since he is more prone to being anxious (though is happy and calm in crate), I imagine these could possibly help. I'm not quite ready for that, but will keep these in mind when the time comes.

The sticks are 5" long and about 2.25" in diameter. They have ridges. The sticks are firm but pliable. Easily can be snapped or cut down in size. My 25 ounce bag had 25 sticks. So, each stick is 1ounce. My bag acquired 9/2019 has a best by date of January 2021. 1 stick has 87 calories. Feeding instructions are; Up to 25 lbs (1/2 stick a day), 26-50 lbs (1 stick per day), Over 50 lbs 1-2 sticks per day.

title: XXL fits two large labs comfortably with room to spare
text:
I recently purchased this XXL pool for my two large labs (93lbs & 83 lbs). I actually wanted it last summer, but didn't want to spend that much money. I bought smaller hard molded plastic pools from a local variety store. They worked enough to play around with or drink from, but neither dog could really play in it or lay down. A larger one (similar to this XXL) wouldn't fit in my truck. A large soft sided variety was too difficult to keep clean (no drain hole, too big to really clean out, also sides too soft and too deep for labs to get in and out of comfortably). SO for this year, I made sure to buy THIS Jasonwell XXL pool. FINALLY a good pool for them. So far so good!

It is perfect for my labs- They can both lay down with some room to spare. The sides are high enough to make deep enough water to play, bob for toys, and lay down in, yet short enough for stubby English lab legs. The pics I included are from the very first time I set it up. I barely had it on the ground before they jumped in. So I just added water as is. I eventually filled it a little more than half way. Since the areas the pool is set up in has a lot of dirt, the pool water needs to be changed frequently. The drain on the bottom side makes it super easy to do so. YAY!!!

My labs aren't likely to chew on the pool, but they may dig at it a little. I keep my dogs nails trimmed, so hopefully that will greatly reduce the risk of harming the pool. The package includes a small tear repair patch and adhesive.

As the season is just starting it will be awhile yet before I have a need to fold it up and put it away. I suppose if I wanted to take it with me somewhere.. I imagine that it will be like trying to fold a map, or fold a fitted sheet in that I will just ball it up and make due. :D But who knows, maybe it will fold easily. I don't really care about that, the main thing is that it holds up to two labs having a good time cooling off on hot days. If they are happy, momma is happy!

We have the C-Shuu. My boy is loving this. It is a perfect texture for him. He is more of a soft toy sort of lab. He loves his stuffies, and toys with "give". No rock hard toys. title: Will not last
text:
I purchased this [[ASIN:B004PB8SRM Tetra 77850 Whisper Air Pump, upto 100-Gallon]] last December. This pump was always a bit loud but it grew to be an annoyance. Our tank is located in our living room and I got fed up with having to turn the TV volume up to drown out the pump. The pump worked for its purposes at first. After about three months, the pump no longer could provide my bubble bar and treasure chest with enough air.. the bar was barely a trickle and the chest hardly ever moved. Yes, I did check my gang valve. The problem was not with my gang valve. So, with the noise and the inability to control the flow, I finally decided to replace my Tetra with something different.

I purchased the [[ASIN:B0013LN10Q EcoPlus 2 Air Pump, 2 Outlets]] two weeks ago and I could not be more pleased. It is decibels quieter and is actually more powerful. I have one 18" submersed bubble bar and one treasure chest in my 20 gallon tank. The lines are run to a gang valve and then a line runs to the pump. This pump is capable of supplying both the bar and chest with the proper amount of flow on the lowest setting. My old Tetra pump had no flow setting control - I considered this and its noise its two downfalls for me and my setup.

I really like the setting control knob on the top of the pump, although I do not see myself needing to turn it up from the lowest setting since with my current setup turning the knob any higher causes my treasure chest to darn near float. LOL! This pump is certainly a very nice device that I foresee lasting me quite some time. When it does come time for a replacement, I will not hesitate to purchase another EcoPlus.

title: Wholesome Treats for Your Dog
text:
Sharing my house with a pair of dogs means having to make special adjustments to my schedule. It also means having to have plenty of food and treats on hand but I don’t want to feed my dogs just anything. I want the food and treats they eat to contain at least a minimal amount of nutritional value and quality ingredients. The Pioneer Woman Grain Free All-Natural Dog Treats measure up to these standards.

These treats are soft and chewy and the ingredient list is short and simple. Chicken is the number one ingredient and beyond that, there are only a handful of other ingredients. This is far better than what you often see on the ingredient list for other dog treats; you know, the unpronounceable list of chemicals so common to other, lower quality treats. What you get with these treats is natural and far more wholesome.

As for the taste, well, my dogs both love these treats immensely! I wasn’t sure at first, mainly due to the apples. I don’t normally find many dog treats made with apples, so I wasn’t so sure they would go for this. I was completely mistaken, as my dogs love these treats more than practically any other treat I have introduced to them, which says a lot.

If I could change one thing about this dog treat, it would be that it last a little longer. The treats are chewy, but not that chewy, and thus they are devoured in a minute or two. But other than this small issue, Pioneer Woman Grain Free All-Natural Dog Treats are a big winner in my household, easily meeting and exceeding my- and both of my dogs- tough standards.

title: Our cats love it and don't mind being told it's healthy! ;)
text: It's good to know this isn't just junk food for cats that'll kill them faster!  I guess it is sort of like a more nutritional 'take-out' at home, in our minds.  Most kibble these days is guaranteed to harm your cat, though they don't tell you that.  After all, there's good money in selling people junk pet food and even better money in treating feline diabetes, right?  Yet cats love kibble like we love McDonalds and we all love convenience, right?  When our vet told us our older cat was way overweight and possibly pre-diabetic, we raced to take our cats off the cheap stuff years ago!  We literally have had to tighten our own belts to feed them better, but vet bills are much worse!  We now feed them grain free, low carb food for the most part, with half their diet being freeze-dried raw and the other half high-priced canned food - Nulo grain-free and human-grade tuna occasionally.  This is the only kibble we give them, in very limited amounts a couple of times a week.  So, this is a good quality treat they cherish!  Oh... and our old kitty has lost a ton of weight though she eats all she wants now!  She has aged issues, but so far we haven't had to treat her for diabetes!  It is interesting how easily she gained weight on cheap food and how many cats have diabetes or are killed by cheap food these days, isn't it?  One hopes there'll be better control of what goes in pet foods, more honesty on packaging in future and that'll lower prices of quality food.  The price on Dr. Elsey's bulk bags isn't bad considering!

title: Keeps Dogs Busy Longer than Most Treats
text:
Dogs love their treats. As dog parents, we try to keep their treat- eating under control, but we love to pamper our pups whenever we can. I prefer dog treats that are a little longer lasting and this is why I like Purina Busy Bones Mini.

Busy Bones Mini are made without rawhide and they have a meaty core that dogs love. They are made with real beef hide and that means dogs are certain to go for the taste! Once my dogs see me reaching for the package, they immediately sit properly and behave themselves, knowing the delicious food that awaits.

I said that I prefer dog treats that are longer lasting and Busy Bones Mini do last longer than the typical dog treat. But because they are small, they don’t last that long, so don’t serve these to your dog thinking it’s going to keep them preoccupied for the next half hour. My dogs are medium to large in size and, from my experience, these last them about 3 minutes. Yes, this is faster than with other dog treats, many of which they inhale in seconds. But they are not super long- lasting, so keep that in mind.

I like to feed my dogs the occasional treats and I like Purina Busy Bones Mini. They last longer than the usual dog treat and with 20 bones in a re-sealable pouch, they are good to have around when you need to give your dog a treat and buy yourself a small amount of time.

title: high calories-332, smell good, large size (may not fit your small dogs mouth), good value
text:
Interesting product. I would not have guessed looking at the treat that it is formulated for "small and medium dogs". I have included pictures of what they look look as I handed them off to my 2 large yellow labradors. The treats are cylindrical in shape, and measure roughly 6" by 1". You will have to determine if that sizing will work with your dogs mouth.

Since this is a treat and offers little in additional nutrients, please be aware that each of these contain 332 calories each. Depending on size of your dog that is easily meals worth of calories or more. I know my one lab receives not much more than that in one of her meals. Definitely an occasional treat for us. This is a calorically expensive treat!!

I will say that I have never purchased an item like this from Purina. We tend to be choosy in that the product and/or company must say that it is made in USA using ingredients sourced within USA. The bag says that these are " proudly produced in Purina owned facilities in USA" and that the label is "Printed in USA". So kind of a red flag for me in terms of lack of transparency and.. weirdness with telling us where the label is printed. Maybe to catch someones eye as they take a quick glance over bags? Not sure. In addition to that, the bag says, "no artificial FD&C colors", but in ingredients has a vague "added color" listed- yet doesn't say where the coloring is derived from. That bothers me. Anyway, thought I would mention it. If that isn't a concern..

These are pretty well priced for a 10 count (2lbs, 4oz) package of rather large treats. If you have a large dog like I do, the size will likely appeal to them. My labs were able to hold it in upright position and gnaw on it. The treat lasted 6 minutes for my girl, and 8 minutes for my boy. Your mileage will vary.

These have an aroma, and I think they smell pretty darn good. I didn't try them (tempted), but know the odor was enticing to my and my cats who were nearby and caught a whiff.

We have dark carpeting, fur covered, not sure if there was any dye stains left behind. I didn't notice, but O also think there wasn't enough time given how quickly my dogs munched these away.

So I gave them one yesterday, and they seem fine in terms of bowel and tummy. No issue, thankfully. I will likely finish off the bag, but slowly. The calorie content is really a concern for me (and I need to look further into Purina company to see where ingredients are sourced).

Other than that, if size seems appropriate to your dog, and the prices seems right.. go for it.

3/5 rating because of super high calories, no specific source for coloring, no clarity on where ingredients comes from. However, they are a good size, reasonably priced, smell really good, and my dogs enjoyed them. Hope this helps!!

title: greatly helps my arthritic 18 years old kitty to get to where he wants to go
text:
I think how well this style will work for you will depend on the needs of your animal. Works great for my elderly cat who at 18 has some arthritis in in rear legs. He goes up and down them just fine. Very sturdy! I can lean on the steps and am not concerned with it falling apart.

Height: 29" (as tall as most desks)
Width: 15.5" roughly
Depth: 23.5"
There are 4 steps contained within that 23.5" base & 29" height.
The height from step to step is 7" (bottom of one step to top of the next), and
The depth of the step is 8", but since there is a little overhang from step above, then I would say 6.5". Keep this in mind as it may not be deep enough for some dogs to comfortably navigate the steps. I think most cats could handle this. In short: consider how much clearance they need.

This is a TALL 29" unit. Is same height as most desks and some beds. The material is a smooth almost plush feel. Some animals may do better with a carpet style. If you have cats and are familiar with the Furhaven self warmer pads, or have Amarkat items, then the material is the same. I have no idea if a dog would use this. I would think that unless they are cat sized, then they would most likely need a less steep angle. This is perfect for a cat.

This unit has been FANTASTIC. It was easy, and kind of fun to put together. The instructions were clear, and the labeling of each piece was correct. No headaches or frustration. Put together inside of 15 minutes.

The base is a hinged board that becomes one solid board once the poles are attached.

I am impressed with how sturdy this 4 step unit is. The carpeting is a soft, plush material. Smooth and short napped, much like their other products.I find it to be amazingly sturdy, especially when it butts up against something.

It took my cats a few days to come around to using it, then once they did it became a normal part of their routine.

At time of purchase, it was bought for use with my two elderly cats in mind, now at time of writing this just the one :( Both have/had weakness in their rear legs, especially my boy who seems to not be able to jump up. He can pull himself up if it is a soft surface to grab onto, or if the steps are short. My girl, who has passed, was able to jump up and down, but I wanted to provide her the added benefit of not having to. We have a younger cat who has used this, but hasn't had a need for it since he can just jump up and down from places. But it also has a lot to do with the current placement.

The 4 step unit is tall. It is 29", so taller than some bed heights. If placed up against a basic bed, it my cat has to step down once he reached the top. If I wanted the steps to be about same height, then I would have gone with the 3 step unit, as it is 25". Anyway, it is exact same as my desk height. It is used as a step to get up onto my desk, which works well. I have an odd set up, which I will explain. My desk then has a twin bed along the same wall, and then another to form an "L" shape.. then a table (which at this point would be on wall across from my desk) where his food and water are. The spot where the table and 2nd bed meet has another set of stairs, but of a different kind (and are shorter). Anyway, this room is set up for the comfort and care of my boy, as well as for my two dogs and other cat. It is where I hang out a lot, so it is where they hang out a lot.

For my boy, I like that he can wander the house, then come back to his room and have a couple of options as to how to get on and off the desk/bed/table set up. From there, my kitty can hang out on my desk with me, or he can walk across the bed to another area to rest. Anything for my babies, and this has been a great addition.

Now, if I didn't want to use this as a step system for the purpose described, I would find it easy to use it elsewhere in the house, or as part of a larger cat climber set up.

My cat seemed to wake from a dead sleep when I opened a treat for Mac and she caught a whiff! lol . ) For whatever reason, I assumed the treats would be hard. Nope. They're soft throughout. The inside contains a soft and creamy churu filling (tuna+salmon) and the outside of the treat is made from a soft chicken paste. A few other limited ingredients are also used to make these treats. I like that the ingredients are very limited.

Mac LOVES his churu treats. He goes bonkers when I get the bag out. I am very pleased everything about these treats. I was especially happy to see the packages CAN be purchased individually. (8 sticks per bag) I thought they had to be purchased 8 packages at at time which I was not prepared to do, cost-wise. Since I can order individua packs of the churu treats, I already DID!!!! I just bought Mac a pack of the chicken and cheese churu treats and I have NO doubt he will love them as much as the chicken + tuna/salmon flavor. Cheese is his FAVORITE food. And, I felt a bit guilty so when I saw INABA makes cat treats as well, I bought the cats a pack of churu treats as well. Mac and I both definitely recommend these tasty treats for your furbabies!

title: My Favorite Covers
text:
I have been cloth diapering for more than a decade now. (Yes, non-stop.) Rumparooz are my absolute favorite cloth diaper covers. There are a few reasons for this. They fit really well at almost every stage. They get super tiny and fit a 6 lb. baby. (Though I do highly recommend the newborn size for tiny babies and then moving to the one size once they outgrow those.) And then they will also fit a 35 lb. toddler. The double gussets mean there will be zero leaks. The elastic on the top- front and back- mean no poop explosions. I have tried so many cloth diapers and covers over the years and these remain my favorites. The thickness of the PUL is perfect. They are very soft and comfortable.
If you find yourself with leak issues with these, I find you’re doing one of two things. (1) You are using a used cover. These do start leaking for me at the end of their lifetime. They still look perfect and new. The elastic still holds great. But they start leaking through the PUL. This is usually after 3-4 YEARS of daily use. (2) You aren’t using enough absorbency in the diaper. If the wetness just sits on the PUL without proper absorbency, you’ll have leaks. (Usually from around the leg seams or the back label seem.) This isn’t a fault of the cover, but of whatever you put under the cover. I find a green mountain prefold under this works perfect during the day with no leaks at all. At night, I have to bump up the absorbency.
